what_to_detect: A permanent turned face down (or entering face down) by an effect has only the characteristics that effect lists, and is a nameless, colourless 2/2 creature with no text, subtypes or mana cost where it lists none.
near_miss: A face-up permanent, with its own characteristics.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: An effect turns a face-up permanent face down, and it takes the face-down characteristics the effect lists.
near_miss: An effect tries to turn an already face-down permanent face down: nothing happens and none of its characteristics or copiable values change.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield face up has its own enters-the-battlefield trigger evaluated and fired.
near_miss: A permanent entering the battlefield face down: none of its enters-the-battlefield triggers is evaluated, so no trigger record of its own exists for the entry; the entry shows as a zone_change to the battlefield with the entity face down.
record_fields: resolution zone_change event to the battlefield

what_to_detect: A candidate that targets spells by a characteristic (colour, name, mana value, type) has no legal target because the spell on the stack is face down and has only the face-down characteristics.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with a face-up spell on the stack that has the characteristic, which is a legal target.

what_to_detect: A turn-face-up candidate (the action a morph, disguise, manifest or cloak rule allows) on a face-down permanent its controller controls is playable while that player has priority.
near_miss: A face-down object with no playable turn-face-up candidate: a face-down spell on the stack, or a face-down permanent another player controls.
record_fields: gen-3 decision candidates (both players, every priority stop)
candidate acting line (Forge builds the action as a Mode$ TurnFaceUp ability joined to the Morph/Disguise keyword line)

what_to_detect: A face-down permanent turned face up takes its normal copiable values while effects that applied to it face down still apply, and no enters-the-battlefield ability of its own triggers.
near_miss: A face-down permanent that is not turned face up keeps the face-down characteristics plus the effects applied to it.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness
face_change event (to_state face_up) on a TurnFaceUp trigger record

what_to_detect: A face-down permanent that became a copy of another permanent keeps the face-down characteristics, and on being turned face up has the values it copied.
near_miss: A face-down copy that is not turned face up stays a nameless 2/2 with no abilities.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: An 'as this is turned face up' replacement applies while the permanent turns face up: what it does (counters, choices) is on the permanent from the moment it is face up, so it never exists face up without it.
near_miss: A face-down permanent with such an ability that is not turned face up, with nothing from it.

what_to_detect: A resolution reveals a face-down permanent and reads the revealed card's own characteristics, ignoring continuous effects on the permanent: a creature card is turned face up.
near_miss: The revealed face-down permanent is not a creature card by its own characteristics and stays face down.
record_fields: state entity face_down before and after
